cards.consumerAndFactSource: storyFacts reads supplied formal evidence and current person identity, returning transient story cards; no authoritative writes.
cards.settlementObjects: One queried person or card; at most 24 retained evidence rows, 12 visible nodes and 8 links per card.
cards.timePrecision: Explicit story read or manual export only; never simulation step or frame.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(E log E) sort and O(E) temporary rows per card, E bounded at 24 for retained evidence; incoming caller rows may be larger before selection.
cards.queryMethod: Direct supplied records and bounded card arrays; identity resolution may scan current plane entities.
cards.rngContract: No RNG calls or draws; restore derives from existing facts.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; every read reconstructs from current world and retained facts.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient cards only; no save field or history extension.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing identity or evidence yields no proven card; death and possession use current identity checks.
cards.testEvidence: WX-S1 and S1.1 controlled evidence, identity, read purity and save tests; source hash independently reviewed and deliberately pinned 2026-11-11.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: storyPeople projects current person, bounded experience ledger and history, site and relationship facts; no writes.
cards.settlementObjects: One requested person; up to 128 history and 24 ledger rows, with site lookup in current plane.
cards.timePrecision: Explicit person story read or manual export only.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(128 log 128 + 24*S) worst case from bounded facts and repeated linear site search; temporary cards/evidence bounded by source histories.
cards.queryMethod: Direct person reference and bounded fact slices; current site lookup scans world.sites.
cards.rngContract: No RNG calls or draws; restore rereads retained facts.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; every query reflects current world and identity.
cards.dataLifetime: No new persistence; source histories retain existing 128/24 limits and cards are transient.
cards.failureAndExit: Dead, migrated, possessed or lost source identities produce conservative interrupted or unproven wording.
cards.testEvidence: WX-S1 people/integration and S1.1 proofreading tests; source hash independently reviewed and deliberately pinned 2026-11-11.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: storyReading resolves explicit references and composes person/object projections; manual world export traverses existing worlds; no writes.
cards.settlementObjects: One requested person/object in production; manual export may inspect all people, artifacts, settlements and three planes.
cards.timePrecision: Player initiated read/refresh or explicit manual export only, never frame or simulation step.
cards.worstCaseCost: Single object lookup may scan all entities and inventories; manual whole-world export repeats object lookups, potentially O(P squared plus A*P) and allocates candidate cards. This is query-time debt, not a per-step bound.
cards.queryMethod: Current plane arrays and formal source histories; no global index or cached object graph.
cards.rngContract: No RNG calls or draws; no extra restore state.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; refresh rebuilds projection from current world.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient cloned display DTOs only; no save fields.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing, duplicate or stale identity refuses unproven navigation; old world references are revalidated.
cards.testEvidence: WX-S1 integration/UI plus S1.1 proofreading read purity and identity tests; source hash independently reviewed and deliberately pinned 2026-11-11.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: storySelection ranks supplied story candidates and chooses bounded visible cards; no authoritative writes.
cards.settlementObjects: Candidate cards supplied by an explicit person/object query or manual export.
cards.timePrecision: Story read/refresh or manual export only.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(C log C) candidate sorting plus O(C) maps and temporary arrays; C can scale with manual whole-world export.
cards.queryMethod: Stable key deduplication and bounded 24 open/96 recent selection, with no world traversal in this module.
cards.rngContract: No RNG draws; stable deterministic ordering.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; selection rebuilt per read.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient selected cards; no save field.
cards.failureAndExit: Duplicate and expired candidates are deterministically deduplicated or omitted.
cards.testEvidence: WX-S1 selection/integration and S1.1 ordering tests; source hash independently reviewed and deliberately pinned 2026-11-11.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: storyWorld projects artifacts and settlement history from existing plane arrays; no writes.
cards.settlementObjects: One requested artifact or settlement; artifact lookup scans ground artifacts and all entity inventories, then at most 10 history rows; settlement uses up to 16 rows.
cards.timePrecision: Explicit object story read or manual export only.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(P + A + V + F) per requested object for array lookup, plus bounded history sort/allocation; repeated manual export can multiply scans by object count.
cards.queryMethod: Current plane array lookup and bounded formal histories; no persistent index.
cards.rngContract: No RNG calls or draws.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; current owner and settlement state rechecked each query.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient cards; existing artifact history 10 and settlement history 16 remain authoritative.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing objects, incoherent owner or lost history produce conservative unresolved wording.
cards.testEvidence: WX-S1 world/integration and S1.1 provenance tests; source hash independently reviewed and deliberately pinned 2026-11-11.
